summary: testOfficialInstallerFallbacksResolveUserLocalAndStandaloneNodeInstalls genuinely exercises real PiExecutableResolver.resolve() with a nil login-shell closure (the 'does not resolve it' premise) and real executable files at both documented installer layouts (~/.local/bin/pi and ~/.local/share/pi-node/current/bin/pi), asserting exact executable/PATH equality; breaking the installer fallback would fail the test. Minor untested edge: a non-nil-but-non-executable shell resolution (stale 'which pi') isn't separately exercised, but the core precondition/outcome is genuinely verified.
